capabilities: generate quiz questions from selected notes and folders using LLM providers
answer generated questions in an interactive quiz UI with real-time feedback
save questions as callouts or obsidian-spaced-repetition flashcards
create and review quiz questions manually without the generator
extras: Two providers (Google and Cohere) are described as free to use; generation requires an API key from the chosen provider, but manually creating and reviewing questions works without one. A large roadmap of upcoming features is listed under 'Coming Soon'.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into interactive quizzes with real-time feedback, or to auto-generate flashcards and exam questions from note content.

relations.evidence: Inline and multiline flashcards compatible with obsidian-spaced-repetition.
OpenAI: Advanced models for high-quality question generation.
Ollama: Local LLMs for enhanced privacy and offline processing.

requires.name: LLM provider (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, Cohere)
provider account to obtain an API key

summary: Quiz generator that creates interactive exam-style questions from selected notes using LLM providers, with a quiz UI, manual question authoring, and spaced-repetition export.
